name: convert_gene_symbol_to_ensembl_id
description: Convert a gene symbol to its corresponding Ensembl gene ID. Use this tool when you have a specific gene symbol (e.g. 'TP53') and need to find its Ensembl ID. Do NOT use this tool for non-standard gene symbols or for retrieving information about multiple genes at once; for batch queries, consider using 'convert_multiple_gene_symbols'.

parameters.name: gene_symbol
parameters.description: The official gene symbol for which to retrieve the Ensembl gene ID. Must be a valid gene symbol recognized by Ensembl (e.g. 'TP53'). Case-insensitive.

gene_symbol.description: The input gene symbol (echoes input, case-insensitive).

status.description: Status of the conversion, indicating success or failure (e.g. 'success', 'not_found').

return_schema.description: Object containing the input gene symbol, the corresponding Ensembl gene ID, and the status of the conversion.
